text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka didn't show up for training, so I'm
out
looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Guess I took the corner a little too hot. I've gotta slow down more next time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's been a while since I played a

motorcycle game. It was fun, but I wanna
hurry up
and get back on the real th—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
choice_data_list: トレーニングの時間だから

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry, Trainer. I was close to setting a
new
record and lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be more careful next time! Catch ya
later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka tries to run, but I catch her at the
last
second and give her a stern
talking-to.
